title: NC-PLUS-SG-4: Decommission mail-sender bindings: remove residual config and verify plugins own all email
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-SG-4 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-SG-4
**Status:** closed

Decommission mail-sender bindings: remove residual config and verify plugins own all email

Backlog done check: email and mailing_list plugins pass live send/list checks with mail-sender bindings, KV entries, and cron triggers removed

Triage: Removing mail-sender worker bindings and cron triggers requires editing wrangler.toml/worker config, which the D1-only doer cannot do. | first step: Edit worker config to drop mail-sender bindings and cron triggers, then run plugins' live send/list checks to confirm they own all email.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
